stories.headline: YELLA BEEZY TRIAL RESUMES
stories.deck: Dallas rapper Markies Conway faces capital-murder allegations as testimony resumes; the state’s theory remains contested.
stories.verified_update: CBS Texas reported that testimony continued on Nov. 5 in Dallas rapper Markies Conway’s capital-murder trial; AllHipHop reported that Conway pleaded not guilty and that the defense challenged the witness account and phone/location evidence.

stories.deck: The Internet for Palestine hits L.A. Nov. 7; tickets and donations support medical relief for children.
stories.verified_update: The AXS event listing confirms bbno$’s Nov. 7 Shrine Expo Hall benefit for the Palestine Children’s Relief Fund; AllHipHop independently reported the lineup and fundraiser framing.

stories.headline: QUAVO SETS THE NEXT MOVE
stories.deck: “One Hit Away” is out with an official video, opening the SATCHAMO rollout; the album still has no confirmed date.
stories.verified_update: HotNewHipHop listed Quavo’s “One Hit Away” as released Nov. 4 and tied it to SATCHAMO; stupidDOPE’s Nov. 5 report likewise described the single and official video as the album rollout’s clearest public step while noting no confirmed album date.

stories.headline: RAP HITS THE BEACH
stories.deck: Morgan Wallen’s 2027 Gulf Shores festival adds Nelly, Gucci Mane and Rick Ross; passes go on sale Nov. 6.
stories.verified_update: The official Sand In My Boots lineup lists Nelly, Gucci Mane and Rick Ross for the May 21–23, 2027 Gulf Shores festival; AllHipHop reported the rap-heavy addition and Nov. 6 public pass sale.

stories.deck: Rockstar released 39 new launch-gallery screenshots two weeks before Nov. 19, expanding the look at Jason, Lucia and Leonida.
stories.verified_update: Rockstar’s Nov. 5 Newswire post announced the GTA VI Launch Gallery; PC Gamer independently counted 39 new screenshots and described the new Jason, Lucia, wildlife and Vice City imagery.
